description: Delete a stored file now, bytes and all. An unsent draft or an email waiting to go out pins the file and answers 409 serverErrors.filePinned: remove it from the draft or cancel the email first. This can't be undone. A key with a read list, or without the operate permission, sees, attaches and deletes only the files it stored itself.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: delete_file
title: Delete a stored file
